question: Under the strongest tested fixed48 restoration gate, does physical maximum-release victim choice improve full-request service against native tail and full-running official-default BidKV score?
workload: Same1024 GSM8K development requests in source order, all arrivals at zero, same Q0 eight-shot prompt and literal Answer: cue; no answer keys in runtime.

action_contract.trigger: Only after genuine native RUNNING allocation_slots None; original native self-victim break remains.
action_contract.candidate_domain: Full native removable running domain: unscheduled suffix including current plus already-scheduled prefix. Report excluded unscheduled prefix if any; do not assume suffix-only is full BidKV.
action_contract.bidkv: Official default score max computed_tokens/(1+0.5*clip(output/max_output_cap,0,1)+0.3*num_preemptions+1e-6); earliest arrival then lexical request_id ties.
action_contract.max_free: Choose maximum number of distinct non-null physical KV blocks made free by releasing all references owned by one candidate; prefer latest running position on ties. Reads current blocks/refcounts only.
action_contract.execution: Reuse the pinned native priority-removal rollback path, with pure selector replacement. FCFS admission, native allocation/free/restore mechanisms and fixed48 admission gate remain.
action_contract.causal_cutoff: No future EOS, actual remaining output length, gold answer, offline future trajectory or model outputs beyond the current state.
action_contract.cost: Scoring and observations execute within measured episode. Log selector wall separately; whole-policy comparison includes all overhead.
action_contract.guarantee: No starvation or future-run guarantee; native self-break kept; no A current guard or continuation mechanism.
action_contract.join: initial_scheduler_step plus every actual selector/preempt event joined to native observer preemption IDs and corresponding native RUNNING failure; verify predicted physical release vs actual pool free delta.

metrics: All original1024 requests: completed/failed/unfinished, correctness/EOS/caps/repetition, TTFT, flow, per-request maximum successive host token gap, token throughput, diagnostic20s/4s SLO-only and correct+SLO goodput, preemption/recomputation and per-request benefit/harm. Policy None and native None separate.

decision_rule.actual_action: Require recorded alternative victim selected and actual native preempt execution; source/CPU fixture alone is UNRUN.
decision_rule.initial_qualification: A pilot signal for repeat requires at least3% lower all-request mean completion or3% higher diagnostic SLO goodput against BOTH controls, with output-token-rate loss at most3% and meanflow increase at most5%. Alternatively at least20% lower worst host gap with those same efficiency guardrails merits a scoped tradeoff repeat.
decision_rule.quality: Retain/report all correctness/EOS/cap changes and every request. A signal with quality or termination regression remains conditional; no filtered-quality timing claim.
decision_rule.baseline_win: If official-default BidKV or native tail covers maximum-free selection, reject independent value of that simple maximum-free rule in this regime. Keep stronger measured control for later work.
decision_rule.negative: Do not tune score weights or add current guard/continuation to rescue this exact pilot on the same outcomes.
decision_rule.invalid: Preserve failed artifacts; diagnose implementation/accounting failure separately from negative policy evidence.
decision_rule.evidence_ceiling: One same-development episode per arm, no significance, no pure equal-work speedup, no held-out or novel algorithm claim.

resource_recovery: Same26GiB RAM,768MiB root disk,2GiB shm guards and inode-verified shared GPU lock.1200s total per arm, release lock during15s waits, child at most once, verify model weights each arm. Post-child lossless xz of three large logs.
resource_budget: 3 GPU episodes;1200s each total including bounded resource waits. Each launcher launches its child at most once.
code_scope: Reuse native generation, model staging, resource guards, output analysis and paired comparison. New core code only substitutes the native victim expression and exposes selected physical block release; rollback copied from pinned native source. Two arms would conflate physical maximum-release with an omitted nearest published scoring baseline. No new framework.
interpretation: Known-style victim rules tested as real action-value experiments. BidKV selector transplanted into C with APC on and fixed48 is a score-component comparison, not full Ascend BidKV system reproduction.
